description: Rows of content that arrive one after another, with one highlight gliding between the rows you can open.
moves: Rows rise out of a soft blur one after another as the list mounts, and the lines between them draw out from the middle.
In a group, one highlight glides to the row under the pointer or the keyboard focus; the lines beside it step aside.
A row that is a link or a button gives a little when pressed and springs back.
A photo in the media slot clears out of a blur as its row arrives.
A chevron in the actions leans toward where the row leads while it is hovered.
keyboard: Moves to the next row that is a link or a button; the highlight follows.
Opens the focused row's link or presses its button.

propDocs.Item.variant: The surface: `"default"` is bare, `"outline"` has a hairline, `"muted"` a soft fill.
propDocs.Item.size: `"sm"` tightens the padding and the gap.
propDocs.ItemMedia.variant: `"icon"` puts the icon in a small well, `"image"` crops a picture to a rounded square, `"default"` leaves it as it is.
